'''Manning''' (Japanese: '''マルフジ''' ''Marufuji'') is a minor recurring character of {{aniseries|BW}}.

==History==
Manning debuted in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where he participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]]. His first opponent was [[Kenton]], whom he defeated and advanced to the next round of the tournament. In ''[[BW091|Battling Authority Once Again!]]'', he battled [[Trip]] in the second round and lost. He made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where he lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]] and [[Freddy O'Martian]].

In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Manning competed in the [[Vertress Conference]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', he appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, meaning that he had made it through the first round. In ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', he appeared once again on the screen of the Vertress Conference, now showing the match-ups for the last sixteen, meaning that he had made it through the second and third rounds. In ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', he lost to [[Russet]], knocking him out of the Vertress Conference. In ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]'', he appeared once again during the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference.
